205447: Atena grew up sheltered from boys. As a result, she can't handle being near them and will get a severe nosebleed if she touches one.
205448: Mineru is a fourth year student who lives in the Seikan's "Goddess Dormitory." Mineru is a researcher who loves working with toxic gas, but due to that she often fails her experiments.
205449: Serene is mysterious, easy-going and docile. She usually doesn't leave the dorm other than for school, but with Koushi's help, she managed to go out on a trip with everyone.

205451: Koshi is quite responsible and mature for his age. Even after being abandoned by his father, he fell into depression and tried to look for a job. When he started to work as dorm mother, even though the girls were older than him, he didn't hesitate to scold them.
